title: JsonUI infra prices v0
description: One file of unit prices for the cost simulator: <infra.dir>/prices/*.json (the folder jui.config.json's infra.prices_dir names) written by a person, and in the same form the prices fetched and the bundled table. USD only. A price is looked up by provider, service, sku, region and unit; the pricing rules (infra/rules) say which. Holds no values (validate refuses the shapes of secrets anywhere in the file). Plan: docs/plans/2026-10-20-jui-viz-backend-load-and-cost-simulator.md.

unit.description: The quantities' units (infra-load.v0 x-unit; a test keeps them in) and the billed ones a rule turns them into: GB-month (storage summed over the hours), instance-hour, vCPU-hour, GB-hour, GB-second, LCU-hour, capacity_unit-hour (a provisioned or serverless capacity unit for an hour) and month (a fixed monthly fee).

tier.description: From from up to to units in the month (to left out: no upper end), at price_usd per per_units.

sku.description: What is priced: an instance type (t3.medium), a class (db.r6g.large), or a dimension's name (requests, gb-seconds).

per_units.description: price_usd is for this many units (1000000 for a price per million requests).

tiers.description: Stepped prices, by the month's total: from 0 upward, in order, not overlapping. With tiers, price_usd is not used.

pool.description: A free amount the provider gives the account across rows (regions, services): taken once from one total for the pool, not per row. A closed list; an unknown pool is an error. aws:data-transfer-out: AWS's 100 GB a month out to the internet, all regions and services together (CloudFront's own free tier aside). azure:container-apps-grant-vcpu / -memory: Azure Container Apps' Consumption grant, 180,000 vCPU-seconds and 360,000 GiB-seconds a month per subscription, across apps and regions.

free.description: Units free each period (the month's total, before the tiers).

price.description: One unit price. Either price_usd or tiers.
